content.text: The largest case builds 400001 canonical rows and completes million-record scalar and batch lookups in under a second locally, with identical output. I’m doing a sanitizer build and a final clean optimized rebuild next.

arguments.command:
set -e
make -C /work/submit clean
make -C /work/submit CXX=g++ CXXFLAGS='-O1 -g -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer'
ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1 /work/submit/planb64 build /work/examples/fib.txt /work/asan.idx
cmp /work/asan.idx /work/examples/expected.idx
ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1 /work/submit/planb64 lookup /work/asan.idx /work/examples/trace.txt scalar > /work/asan.out
cmp /work/asan.out /work/examples/expected.txt
sed 's/range(150)/range(20)/; s/\[1,2,3,7,16,255,256,\x27003\x27,\x27000001\x27\]/[1,3,256,\x27003\x27]/' /work/test_planb.py > /work/test_planb_asan.py
